luiskr.com / core/utils/motion/scroll-spring / cancelSpringScroll

function cancelSpringScroll(track, animClass): void

Defined in: core/utils/motion/scroll-spring.ts:169

Cancels a live spring — user-input takeover (wheel/touch): the track stays wherever the spring left it and mandatory snap re-engages from the lifted class. The caller's onSettle is dropped — a cancelled nav must not fire its teleport.

Parameters

track

Element

The scrolling element.

animClass

string

The modifier class to lift.

Returns

void
